task: Primary study-interest classification only; not programme quality, English eligibility or admission prediction.
test_set: 37 synthetic cases in evals/intent_cases.json. GPT-4.1 mini assisted with writing and labelling them before the Gemini run.
limitations: Small synthetic set with model-assisted labels, not independent human validation. Four of seven out-of-scope cases received an in-scope label. English programme metadata and the English-token local fallback limit Chinese performance.

academic_evidence_regression_check.scope: Deterministic regression check for the implemented academic-preparation evidence rule; not an admissions prediction or admissions-accuracy evaluation.
